job.prompt: Create a realistic B2B image for an OEM custom packaging capability section. Show a professional tool packaging line or display: blister packs of hand tools on a retail-style backing card, a custom branded retail toolkit box, and a white-label toolkit case displayed together. The visual should communicate manufacturing flexibility and brand-program capability. Clean, professional, packaging-focused. No consumer discount aesthetic, no clutter. Suitable for a export manufacturer's capabilities page.
